inventory.note: Inventory is limited to resources visible to Azure Resource Graph for the collector identity; resource types that Azure Policy does not evaluate cannot be assessed.

metadata.note: Severity is only shown when the definition's own metadata carries it. Categories come from definition metadata, never guessed.

cisNotAssessed: CIS benchmark results are only shown for machines with an actual CIS guest assignment; otherwise they are 'not assessed'.

defender.note: Defender for Cloud data is shown separately and is never merged into Azure Policy compliance.

limits: Policy states are the latest evaluation per resource and policy; history is built from collection snapshots, not from Azure.
Exempt, Unknown and not-started evaluations are excluded from compliance %.
Resources that Azure Policy does not evaluate are not part of any denominator.
